summary: Iteration 3: backend regression 5/5 passed. Proposal sheet submit is now inside the 390x844 viewport and UI acceptance/banner passed. Create wizard could not advance because its Continuar control is laid out outside the viewport.

ui_bugs.issue: On 390x844, the step footer/Continuar control is visually at the bottom but its layout box is outside the viewport; Playwright cannot tap it, blocking the four-step create flow.
Home screen has no stable home-screen testID, preventing the prescribed initial load selector; visible home content loaded successfully.

integration_issues.issue: Could not complete UI publish/reopen verification because the first Continuar tap is outside viewport.

issues: Footer/action layout overflows mobile viewport despite being visually present.

action_items: Fix CreateModal mobile footer/layout so Continuar and Publicar pedido have tappable bounding boxes within 390x844, then retest full publish and reset flow.
Add data-testid=home-screen to the root home view for reliable regression testing.
Align frontend API environment key with the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract; current preview uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Completion and rating UI are not implemented in index.tsx although backend endpoints exist and MVP includes these flows.
seed_data_creation: Regression tests and UI created TEST-prefixed orders/proposals/messages; no cleanup endpoints exist.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Proposal button now measured y=776, height 50 on 390x844 and acceptance banner appeared. CreateModal Continuar still fails outside viewport; stop after repeated attempts.
rca_of_issue: Proposal layout fix succeeded by constraining sheet height/footer. CreateModal still uses a full-screen Modal with ScrollView plus absolutely positioned footer; on web preview the action text resolves below the viewport, so tapping cannot advance. Mitigation: constrain modal content height and keep footer in a non-scrolling flex column, then verify bounding boxes.
